description: Height is energy. The Pursuer is at 40 000 ft, the Target at 10 000 ft. A missile fired from high up starts faster in thin air and can glide down, so the launch zone reaches about 125-130 km (see LAUNCH_ZONE_ENTERED in the event log). Looking down also means the radar beam hits the ground behind the Target, so the track can flicker out (RADAR_TRACK_DROPPED, DATALINK_LOST). Press R to go back to t=0, then set the Pursuer's Placement 'Altitude' to 10000 (Placement edits only before the clock runs): the zone shrinks to about 80-90 km and the shot comes later and slower.
